title: Receipt
description: The machine-readable Proof Pack (ARCHITECTURE.md 5, 16). FROZEN. Written only by verify/; no Phase 1 code path produces one. Sub-record internals are left open where the phase that fills them defines their shape.

proof_scope.description: The scope this receipt is bound to. A new SHA kills this receipt; a new proof is required (law L4).

unexplained.description: Law L1 made mechanical: a receipt carrying a non-zero unexplained count is not a representable record.

oracle_authority.description: Which authority accepted the requests (P-020, P-022). LIVE is the provider itself. CATALOG is the pack's own version catalog, never the provider; what a CATALOG acceptance does and does not prove is stated by each accepting check's own reason and is never asserted generically here, because a generic claim goes stale the moment a pack learns a new check. ORACLE_UNAVAILABLE is no decision at all. Required so a receipt can never stay silent about the strength of its own oracle evidence.

frozen_baseline_tests.description: Tests copied from the base SHA. These are the proof (law L11).

candidate_tests.description: Tests as they exist on the candidate SHA. These are evidence only (law L11).

unknowns.description: Every preserved UNKNOWN with its closing instruction. An UNKNOWN without one is not a representable record.

verdict.description: Never SAFE (law L8). VERIFIED_FOR_SCOPE is scoped to proof_scope and nothing wider.
